top_findings.title: No README.md with setup and run instructions
top_findings.evidence: No README file exists in run_dir (ls README* -> no matches; find . -iname '*readme*' -> nothing). Agent stdout claims code+tests but never mentions a README; only 'README' hits in _hermes_session.jsonl are the echoed TASK.md deliverables text.
top_findings.suggestion: Add a README.md documenting `go mod download`, `go run .` (listens on :8080), the endpoints, and `go test ./...`.
